In the middle distance two or three volunteers in ordinary clothes collaborating and learning electronics; do not portray identifiable real people. Shelves, a window onto a modest courtyard and an open doorway add depth. Palette: deep ink/navy and charcoal shadows, warm off-white, muted Ukrainian blue and sunflower yellow accents, restrained cyan instrument highlights, warm practical task lights. Render crisp deliberate pixel clusters and stepped diagonals; consistent pixel density, no painterly blur or photorealism. Large simple light/dark masses keep both cyan and amber game actors readable if overlaid. Interesting details concentrated in lower corners and upper edges; central area quiet but still a finished picture. One continuous original illustration; no borders, typography, labels, emblems, logos, UI, grids, watermarks, ammo or weapons. Inspired by documented community electronics/soldering education, not a copy of any photo, no claims of exact real premises. Requested output 1536x768 PNG (2:1). Full opaque art, preserve all composition in frame. This is a source candidate; actual output dimensions will be inspected and recorded, not assumed.
